# I Love Islam — llms-full.txt

> I Love Islam (iloveislam.life) helps visitors memorise the Quran by reciting
> aloud and getting word-by-word feedback. Free, no sign-up, no account.
> Quran text, translations and tafsir are sourced from Quran.com; audio is
> from named reciters. This tool checks which words were recited — it does
> not check tajweed, and a teacher is still needed for tajweed.

## Hifz hub

- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz): Hifz hub — start memorising, continue where you left off, plans and streak.
- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/plans](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/plans): Memorisation plans — 7-day and 30-day plans per surah, Juz Amma 90-day plan.
- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/my-progress](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/my-progress): My progress — streak, daily goal, mistake log, export/import (stored on the user's device only).
- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz-amma](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz-amma): Juz Amma (Juz 30) — all 37 short surahs, shortest first, the beginner path.
- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz/30](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/juz/30): Juz 30 overview — same content as Juz Amma.
- [https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/ayat-al-kursi](https://www.iloveislam.life/hifz/ayat-al-kursi): Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) — single-ayah study page; Quran text via Quran.com.
